instruction.text: Quỳnh und Harry treffen sich, um sich über die Sportarten auszutauschen, zu denen sie recherchiert haben. </br>Vervollständige den Dialog.
instruction.sound: Qwinn und Harry treffen sich, um sich über die Sportarten auszutauschen, zu denen sie recherchiert haben. Vervollständige den Dialog.

atoms.a: Lass uns damit anfangen, die verschiedenen Sportarten einander vorzustellen.
atoms.b: Let's start by introducing the different ((++sports matches)) to each other.
atoms.sound: Let's start by introducing the different sports to each other.

atoms.a: Ja klar. Willst du anfangen?
atoms.b: Oh yeah, sure. Do you want to ((++start end))?

atoms.a: Ja, lass mich schnell meine Notizen herausholen...

atoms.sound: Yes, let me quickly take out my notes...

instruction.text: Harry stellt Quỳnh seine Notizen vor. Höre aufmerksam zu und lies mit.

atoms.sound: Golf is an outdoor sport. The goal is to move a small white ball into a hole using a club. A match consist of 18 holes. The person who plays the holes with the least number of shots wins. Golf is a sport that has a certain dress code. People usually wear formal shorts or trousers and a collared shirt.

instruction.text: Ordne die Bilder und Wörter einander zu.

atoms.a: clubs
hole
dress code

atoms.sound: There are different kinds of gymnastics. Two examples are artistic and rhythmic gymnastics. Artistic gymnastics are exercises on the floor, rings or parallel bars. Rhythmic gymnastics are floor exercises. The athletes perform a choreography with hoops and ribbons.

instruction.text: Wähle das jeweils richtige Bild aus.

atoms.sound: Triathlon is a sport that includes three disciplines. Swimming, Cycling and Running. The distances of the individual disciplines can vary. At the Olympic Games, the athletes first have to swim 1.5 kilo'meters, then cycle for 40 kilo'meters and lastly run for another 10 kilo'meters.

instruction.text: Bringe die einzelnen Disziplinen beim Triathlon in die richtige Reihenfolge.

atoms.sound: Chess is a board game that two people play against each other. One after the other, they move their chess pieces in different patterns across the board and beat the opponent's chess pieces. The most important chess piece is called King. It's the goal to put the opponent's King in a situation where he can't escape the other team.

atoms.a: Which is the most important character in Chess?

instruction.text: Höre aufmerksam zu und lies mit.

Federball.</voice> racket <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet Schläger.</voice>

atoms.sound: Badminton can be played one-on-one or in teams of two. The court is divided into two halves by a net. You need to get 21 points to win a game. When the shuttlecock hits the opponent's part of the court, you get a point. If you touch the net with your body or the racket, the opponent will get a point.

racket

instruction.text: Höre aufmerksam zu und lies mit.

atoms.sound: E-sports describes the professional competition of playing video games. There are different categories of games in e-sports, for example: Games where you play an athlete or a team; games that look like virtual chess; or games where you fight with characters.

atoms.a: Ich wusste nicht, dass das Spielen von Videospielen eine Sportart ist.
atoms.b: I didn't know that playing ((++video_games sports)) is considered a sport.
atoms.sound: I didn't know that playing video games is considered a sport.

atoms.a: Ich war auch überrascht. Es gibt sogar Meisterschaften.
atoms.b: I was ((++surprised scared)) about that too! There are even ((++championships champignonships)).
atoms.sound: I was surprised about that too! There are even championships.

atoms.a: Das ist so cool! Aber ich erinnere mich gar nicht daran, dass E-Sports eine Disziplin bei den Olympischen Spielen ist.
atoms.b: This is so cool! But... I don't remember seeing e-sports as a discipline at the Olympic Games.
atoms.sound: This is so cool! But I don't remember seeing e-sports as a discipline at the Olympic Games.

atoms.a: Ja, das stimmt. Auch wenn E-Sports ziemlich beliebt zu sein scheint, erkennt das Olympische Komitee es noch nicht als offizielle Sportart an.
atoms.b: Yes, that's true. Even though e-sports seems to be quite ((++popular unknown)), the Olympic committee doesn't ((++accept answer)) it as an officially recognized sport yet.
atoms.sound: Yes, that's true. Even though E-sports seems to be quite popular, the Olympic committee doesn't accept it as an officially recognized sport yet.

atoms.a: Weißt du warum?
Das ist hauptsächlich so, weil E-Sports virtuell stattfindet. Außerdem wird E-sports eher als Spiel und nicht als Sportart angesehen.
atoms.b: It's mainly because e-sports take place ((++virtually video)). Also, e-sports are seen rather as gaming and not a sport.
atoms.sound: It's mainly because e-sports is taking place virtually. Also, e-sports is seen rather as gaming not a sport.

atoms.a: Aber warum ist Schach dann ein „echter“ Sport? Das ist ja auch nur ein Brettspiel ... Das ist nicht fair.
atoms.b: But why is ((++chess badminton)) a “real” sport then? It's also just a ((++board_game sport_board)) ... That doesn't sound fair.
atoms.sound: But why is Chess a real sport then? It's also just a board game... That doesn't sound fair.

atoms.a: Das Problem liegt in der Definition von „Sport“. Das Olympische Komitee sagt, dass Sport etwas Körperliches ist und dass es Vereine für jede Sportart geben muss, die bei den Olympischen Spielen vertreten ist.
atoms.b: The problem is the definition of “sport”. The Olympic ((++Committee Composer)) says that sport is something physical and there must be sports clubs for every sport of the Olympic Games.
atoms.sound: The problem is the definition of “sport”. The Olympic committee says that sport is something physical and there must be sports clubs for every sport of the Olympic Games.

atoms.a: Ich hoffe, dass sie bald ihre Meinung dazu ändern. Vor allem verglichen mit Schach sehe ich keinen Grund, weshalb E-Sports keine offizielle Sportart sein sollte.
atoms.b: I hope they'll change their minds about that soon. Especially ((++compared combined)) to chess, I don't see why e-sports shouldn't be an official sport.
atoms.sound: I hope they'll change their minds about that soon. Especially compared to Chess, I don't see why e-sports shouldn't be an official sport.

atoms.a:
In dem Artikel, den ich gelesen habe, stand, dass es nur noch eine Frage der Zeit ist, bis sie
E-Sports als eine offizielle Sportart anerkennen.
atoms.b: The article I read said that it's just a matter of time until they will accept e-sports as an ((++official awesome)) sport.
atoms.sound: The article i read said that it's just a matter of time until they will accept e-sports as an official sport.
